title: PeopleSoft Studio's App Engine writer replays App Designer's captured saves: every replay test passes
statement: src/test/appEngineWriter.test.ts rebuilds App Designer's captured saves (HRDMO, PeopleTools 8.62.09) through Studio's App Engine writer and requires App Designer's rows and counters; every top-level test passed in the recorded run. Evidence about Studio, not PeopleSoft (rule 3); it says nothing about releases not captured. docs/APP_ENGINE.md lists the cases.

observations.observation: Run of src/test/appEngineWriter.test.ts (node:test, TAP): 8 top-level tests, all passed.

testResults.name: plans move the counters App Designer moved
a step rename moves its SQL (ENABLEEFFDT N, PSSQLDEL) and its PeopleCode (PSPCMPROGDEL) [ar01]
re-creating a deleted key removes its tombstone [ae17]; a section delete writes one [ae16]
a new program plans App Designer's create: AEM, AES, SYS + 1; LICENSE_CODE blank [ae01]
SQL typed in the editor is flattened; unchanged stored SQL is never rewritten
PeopleCode that does not compile is refused, never written
creating a program whose name was deleted removes its tombstones, as App Designer's next save does [nae01]
